Grenada: Grenada: non-nationals need an Alien Landholding Licence (ALHL) — budget ~10% of price + legal; also a Citizenship-by-Investment route.
Brazil: Brazil: foreigners may own urban and most titled land freely; but RURAL land is capped/needs INCRA approval for larger areas, and land within 150 km of a land border (faixa de fronteira) needs national-security clearance. Verify título + georreferenciamento.
